text: {"table": {"name": "pitStops", "purpose": "Formula 1 pit stop records: one row per pit stop made by a driver during a race, with the lap, local time, and stop duration."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "raceId", "description": "Identifier of the race (references races). Same race appears many times, once per pit stop.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "driverId", "description": "Identifier of the driver making the pit stop (references drivers).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "category", "name": "stop", "description": "Pit stop number for that driver in the race (1st, 2nd, ... up to 6).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "category", "name": "lap", "description": "Lap number on which the pit stop occurred (1-74).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "category", "name": "time", "description": "Local race time of day (HH:MM:SS) at which the pit stop occurred.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "category", "name": "duration", "description": "Pit stop duration in seconds (stored as text, e.g. '30.888').", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "category", "name": "milliseconds", "description": "Pit stop duration in milliseconds; equals col_006 * 1000 (e.g. 30888 for 30.888).", "status": "resolved"}}}
